g.text: ETDA Trusted List Load (lazy pull from the ETDA CDN , used by the issuance and presentation sequences)
Load ETDA Trusted List (when a transaction needs it)
[SPEC] VCVP Core issuance : iss.txt , wp.txt | VCVP Core presentation : ver.txt , wp.txt , iss.txt
• 12.8 (MUST , MUST NOT) lazy pull , no polling
• 12.8.1 fetch and verify the Trusted List
Get ETDA public key | GET https://etda.or.th/.well-known/did.json
• appendix 8.1 D.1.1 (MUST) fetch the Trusted List
200 compact signed JWT + ETag | 304 Not Modified
• 11.3 (MUST , MUST NOT) alg bound to the key type , not taken from the JWT header alone
• 14.2.1 T4 LoTESequenceNumber , ListIssueDateTime and NextUpdate checked with clock skew
[SPEC] clock skew at most 60 seconds (value set by VCVP , the same as the KB-JWT iat check)
Verify the Trusted List signature with the ETDA key , alg matches the key type (ES256 = EC P-256 , EdDSA = Ed25519) , not taken from the header alone
LoTEType = the type of this list , ListIssueDateTime , LoTESequenceNumber not lower than the cached one , NextUpdate not passed
time checks allow a clock skew of at most 60 seconds
Save the file and the new ETag
[Signature , LoTEType , LoTESequenceNumber , ListIssueDateTime or NextUpdate check fails]
Reject the file , keep the cached Trusted List unchanged

• 7.7 item 1 , Cache freshness (MUST) after NextUpdate the old status is not treated as active
• 9.3 item 3 fail-closed or fail-open is stated
[SPEC] answer of the calling step when the Trusted List is not usable : 503 Service Unavailable + Retry-After: 300 (value set by VCVP)
FailureReason = TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE , not the trust failure reason of that step

[SPEC] wallet side : DW Core keeps the cached file for the app , the app verifies the signature again before use
